schema.description: One record per case in 'cases'. A case is one starter deck (runnable=true) or one not-runnable payload. Paths are absolute Windows paths with forward slashes. E: sources were never modified.

case_fields.package: zip stem / tutorial dir the case came from
case_fields.case_dir: extracted directory holding the starter deck
case_fields.starter_deck: absolute path of the *_0000.rad/D00 starter (null when not runnable)
case_fields.runnable: true iff a starter deck exists
case_fields.has_engine_deck: false = starter exists but no engine file
case_fields.embedded_engine_block: true = the starter FILE itself carries an engine block (/RUN../END/ENGINE) before /BEGIN — hybrid single-file deck
case_fields.format_version: Invers from the /BEGIN block (e.g. 2017, 110); null for old/unversioned decks
case_fields.approx_nodes / approx_elements: data-card line counts under /NODE and element keywords (approximate)
case_fields.starter_families: sorted first-two-path-segment keyword families of starter + includes
case_fields.unsupported_families: starter families NOT in the pyradioss dispatch envelope (control noise ignored) = unsupported_hard + unsupported_soft
case_fields.unsupported_hard: unsupported families that are MODEL/PHYSICS content — real blockers
case_fields.unsupported_soft: unsupported families the port skips with a warning while the run and its physics stay intact (TH/* output kinds, SUBSET, ACCEL, RANDOM noise amplitude 0.001)
case_fields.engine_unsupported_families: informational; engine key0s outside the ported engine set
case_fields.classification: graded on unsupported_hard only: IN_ENVELOPE (0) | NEAR (<=2) | OUT | NOT_RUNNABLE
case_fields.classification_strict: same grading on ALL unsupported families (soft ones included)
case_fields.reference_outputs: pre-run Fortran outputs next to the deck (…T01 time history, .out listings) that were extracted
case_fields.reference_outputs_filtered: reference payloads (h3d, A-anim) noted but not extracted
